## Decisions

- Compact sell/receive panels and a searchable token directory, based on the supplied Jupiter reference. Preserve SYMBaiEX colors, shared Dialog/Button primitives, responsive behavior and explicit transaction review.
- Full-width connected trading desk, based on the supplied Birdeye reference: wide chart, persistent order column, compact asset/metric strips and sortable sampled-market rows. Keep forum navigation, Geist/magenta/teal identity, real source timestamps and mounted protected receipts; no invented rankings or unsupported trading controls.
- Viewport terminal: a route-local bounded workspace below the shared header. Flexible Chart/Markets analysis, a persistent 328px internally scrolling execution pane, and an expandable lower tools drawer replace document stacking. At a workspace width of 840px or less, one safe-area-aware dock reveals focused Chart, Markets, Trade, Receipts and Tools views while preserving mounted controllers. Keep wallet/watches, research, community and treasury accessible, source ages and consent readable, and known private protection counts outside hidden panes. Do not infer an all-clear state. Only the valid enabled website workspace replaces the global footer/mobile forum navigation; retain 44px touch targets.
